checkout(uint256[],uint256[],uint256).details: Duplicate IDs are permitted; quantity limits apply per line. State is      recorded before transfer; a failed transfer reverts the entire order.

params.ids: Active product IDs, in purchase order.
params.maxTotal: Maximum total the buyer authorizes in raw USDC units.
params.qtys: Quantities of 1–100 for each corresponding ID.

params.initialOwner: Account authorized to manage products and the merchant.
params.initialPrices: Nonzero prices fitting in uint128, assigned IDs starting at 1.
params.usdc_: USDC token address; must use 6-decimal raw units.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.active: Whether the product may be purchased.
params.price: Nonzero raw USDC price fitting in uint128.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

checkout(uint256[],uint256[],uint256).notice: Purchase 1–20 lines using an existing USDC allowance to this contract.

constructor.notice: Configure the token, payment recipient, owner, and 1–50 active products.

getBuyerOrderIds(address).notice: Return all order IDs placed by a buyer, oldest first.

getOrder(uint256).notice: Return a stored order, reverting if its ID does not exist.

getProducts().notice: Return the full product catalog in ascending ID order.

orderCount().notice: Return the number of successfully placed orders.

setMerchant(address).notice: Change the recipient of future checkout payments.

setProduct(uint256,uint256,bool).notice: Update an existing product or append the next sequential product.
